Thai Lemongrass Soup
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, March 24, 2010 - 1:13am

Ingredients




8 cups chicken stock
1/2 - 1 bunch cilantro
1 can straw mushroom
16 large shrimps, peeled, deveined
1 cup snow peas
 cup shredded carrots (just for color)
juice of 1 lime
1/2 - 1 tsp. crushed red pepper
1 chili pepper, cut into rings
4 tablespoons nam plah (you can find at Oriental food stores)
a few stalks of lemongrass (use about 6)

Preparation

1 Bring the broth to a simmer. Add cruched red pepper and shrimp. simmer for 5 min. Add lemongrass and simmer for another 5 min. Add the rest of the ingredients and simmer a few minutes more. Be careful not to over cook or the vegitables will lose their color and will get limp. 2 Submitted by: RC
